entities.name: PMID:10725769
observations: Randomized two-period crossover study in 15 young healthy women; compared breakfast with versus without 15 g inulin across cheese (210 mg calcium) and calcium-supplement (210 mg) conditions; sampled at 0, 2, 4, 6, and 8 hours.

entities.name: Acute inulin breakfast null effect
observations: In a randomized crossover study of 15 young healthy women, adding 15 g inulin to breakfast did not significantly change serum ionized calcium or intact PTH; 8-hour concentration-curve AUCs did not differ versus control. PMID:10725769.
